newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila bourse halts trade in seven companies.
newsitem.headline: Manila bourse halts trade in seven companies.

text.p: The Philippine Stock Exchange (PSE) on Thursday temporarily halted trading in shares of seven companies participating in the bidding of the Metropolitan Waterworks and Sewerage System (MWSS).

Earlier, the PSE said trading of Benpres Holdings Corp, Ayala Corp, Aboitiz Equity Ventures Inc, Metro Pacific Corp, House of Investments, and Dharmala Philippines Inc would be temporarily stopped at 9:45 a.m. (0145 GMT), about an hour before the opening of their MWSS financial bids.
The PSE surveillance department said it later included the APC Group Inc in the list because it is a part of the Metro Pacific group.
The bourse official said the halt order will be lifted 30 minutes after the result of the bidding has been disseminated to the brokers.
Bids are scheduled to be opened at 11 a.m. (0300 GMT).
